definitions.frame_index: Zero-based; a step index is its destination frame (i-1 -> i).
definitions.step_length_ratio: norm(estimated local translation) / norm(GT local translation)
definitions.step_vector_error: norm(estimated local translation - GT local translation) / norm(GT local translation)
definitions.moving_step: GT step >= 0.1 m; shorter steps excluded from relative step counts.
definitions.block_error: Relative pose error between block endpoints, divided by GT path length; diagnostic only, not KITTI RTE.
